activity.notes: Boruth is the first documented named prince of Carantania. Scholarship places his rule approximately c.740-c.750. Around 740 he sought Bavarian help against the Avars and subsequently accepted Bavarian overlordship. ATLAS preserves Carantania as the represented polity rather than replacing it with Bavaria.

sources.title: KARANTANIYA — Great Russian Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia identifies Boruth as prince of Carantania around 740 and dying around 750, and notes Carantania's acceptance of Bavarian overlordship after seeking aid against the Avars.
